Validation uses reduced output and applicable thinking budgets and a shorter timeout without changing saved production parameters. providerSettings.deleted: API configuration deleted. Apply changes when the target is idle.

providerSettings.extraBodyHelp: Enter a JSON object up to 64 KiB; blank or {} clears it. Parameters apply only to this model, without changing other models under this API and override matching extension fields; model, messages, input, system, instructions, tools and stream cannot be overridden. Do not include API keys or credentials. Saving validates the model with these parameters; new conversations use the saved configuration.
providerSettings.extraBodyReserved: Extra request body cannot override the runtime-managed field {{field}}. Remove it and retry.
providerSettings.extraBodyInvalid: Extra request body must be a valid JSON object no larger than 64 KiB.
providerSettings.keyHelp: Enter your API Key above; no .env editing is needed. Saving writes the key to the selected runtime target’s credentials file, without displaying it in the list or storing it in the browser. Leave it blank to keep the existing key. Only save keys to trusted targets and protect their credentials files.
providerSettings.saved: Saved without changing running models. Apply the configuration when the target is idle.
providerSettings.loadFailed: Could not load API configuration. Check the target connection and KCoder version.
providerSettings.saveFailed: Could not save. Check the format, endpoint, model ID, token limits and target directory permissions.
providerSettings.restartHelp: Applying restarts connected workspaces on the selected target. Running tasks, terminals and other clients block restarting; nothing is forcibly interrupted.

toolProfile.description: Choose the built-in tools offered to the model in new conversations. Permissions and conversation modes can restrict them further.
toolProfile.appliesToNewSessions: New conversations read this configuration; explicit command-line options take precedence. Existing conversations keep their tools. No Studio restart is required.
toolProfile.cliOverride: This target has an explicit command-line override. New conversations use {{profile}} instead of the saved choice.
toolProfile.chooseTarget: Select a runtime target to configure its tools.
toolProfile.loadFailed: Failed to load the target toolset.
toolProfile.saveFailed: Failed to save the target toolset.
toolProfile.unsupported: Upgrade the selected KCoder target to configure its toolset.
toolProfile.fullHelp: Includes skill discovery and activation tools, alongside the full built-in toolset.
toolProfile.coreHelp: Keeps core tools without autonomous skill discovery or activation. You can still select skills in Studio.
toolProfile.nanoHelp: A minimal toolset without autonomous skill discovery or activation. You can still select skills in Studio.
toolProfile.noneHelp: The model receives no tools. Skill installation and user-selected skills in Studio remain available.

workflowCanvas.composerHint: Generate a workflow through conversation in this project, without executing its tasks.
workflowCanvas.conversationHint: Describe or refine the workflow in the conversation. Errors and retries stay there. Publishing saves a version without running it.
workflowCanvas.runInstruction: Use the saved workflow, reference: {{params}}. Read this exact saved version and determine arguments from this conversation. workflowCanvas.invalidJsonObject: Enter a valid JSON object before saving.
workflowCanvas.noRuns: No runs yet. Generating or saving does not execute nodes.

workflowReuse.empty: No matching saved workflows. Save a runnable version in Workflows first.
workflowReuse.objectRequired: Run arguments must be a JSON object.
workflowReuse.listLimit: The workflow list is too large. Manage workflows and try again.

workflowReuse.conversationHint: Describe your requirements in chat. The model reads this version and asks for missing information; filling a form is optional.
